desc: negative: dev=eth0 arx=absent atx=absent rxu=u32wrap rxf=absent txu=absent txf=absent irq=absent rate=absent lowhigh=absent cqe=absent aggr=absent rxcqe=absent: a count over the u32 range
pre: i=$((900+$(ip netns identify | tr -dc 0-9))); echo $i > /sys/bus/netdevsim/del_device 2>/dev/null; echo "$i 1 4" > /sys/bus/netdevsim/new_device && ip link show eth0 >/dev/null
